say:0:1012128001:0.text: Hey, younglings! Yes, I'm calling to you. Come here!
say:0:1012128001:0.source_cn: 喂——年轻人，对……就是在叫你们，快来我这里。

say:1:1012128002:0.text: Magister Merlin, she's the elder of Taran Village!
say:1:1012128002:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，那位是塔兰村的村长。
say:1:1012128002:0.male: Magister Merlin, she's the elder of Taran Village!
say:1:1012128002:0.female: Magister Merlin, she's the elder of Taran Village!
